scope: Fresh corrected grouped-expert path only, same4096/1024 E2Ecase

selection_basis.decode: Log-spaced observed occupancy and size anchors through100; frequent intermediate shapes are held out
selection_basis.single_prefill: Observed4096 boundary and first padding transitions, then interior/end of observed range
selection_basis.double_prefill: Observed low/mid/high with two interior holdouts
selection_basis.triple_prefill: Two observed sizes split into training and heldout

acceptance.numerical_correctness: Same-input vLLM fused_experts equality on collected layouts
acceptance.prediction: Fresh corrected-only GG training; actual feature-key/RF receipt on untouched holdouts
acceptance.gate: Report absolute ms, signed/absolute relative error, variance and frequency-weighted contribution; add samples only to a failed observed region
acceptance.full_case: Run fresh same-case with updated cost; audit any newly reached feature/shape before declaring coverage complete

caveats: This is a bounded supplementation proposal, not all188shape exact coverage
Frozen train/holdout manifest must be applied explicitly; current exact script labels only4096/4097 anchor, so adapt only task-specific driver for future GG-only collection
No public routing schema or traced routing import extension is needed
No old incomplete-GG timing may enter training
Synthetic prefill_hot GG data is diagnostic and does not replace existing context merely for favorable agreement
